title: KSMP
description: A Adventure and Tech Focused Modpack, Designed for SMPs
body:
## A Modpack Focused on Tech and Adventure Mods Designed for SMPS

### Overview
- Biome's O Plenty, Terralith and Entire YUNG's mods for Custom Biomes and Structures
- Create Paired with Mekanism for Tech
- Social Mods Designed for SMPS
- No Quests! Progress at your own pace

### Performance
This Modpack is optimized for Mid-range devices
Tested on GTX 1060 3GB + Ryzen 7 1700 (8c/16t)

4GB Ram Allocated, No JVM, Fog Disabled
- 150-170 fps when moving + generating chunks
- 185-205 fps when not moving

_**Complimentary Shaders is disabled by default
Go to Setting > Video Settings > Shader Packs to enable**_

Modlist: [modlist.txt](https://gist.githubusercontent.com/Kaori10498/2ad2bcbe8b2b9c87ce2269cd8d2c3574/raw/6ce5d347ea00f6e676d6a0e72f96c7921a83255f/modlist.txt)

Made by Kaori and Kyu with <3
